Good for a demanding effort without a long single day, though the riders with no experience will need practice time first. Destination, ages, access needs and the trip's rule-out conditions were not answered.

candidatesAccepted.title: Péribonka to Chicoutimi return by trail
candidatesAccepted.summary: A return-direction groomed-trail movement that keeps the riders close to a planned stop and ends back near the start. It suits a mixed-experience party, but I did not verify whether the trail is open or groomed in the window you gave, so please check locally before relying on it.

candidatesAccepted.title: Basic cabin on a groomed trail
candidatesAccepted.summary: A simple rustic cabin near a groomed snowmobile trail suits the roughest night the party will accept and keeps daily riding short. The destination was not answered, so the town is unknown, and riders' ages, access needs, and what would rule the trip out are also unknown, so none of these were accounted for. Season and booking lead time are unchecked, so they are left null.

place.name: rustic cabin on groomed snowmobile trail

candidatesAccepted.title: Simple gîte near a snowmobile trail hub
candidatesAccepted.summary: A plain guesthouse with a heated common room, close to a groomed trail network, offers a simple night without long off-trail transfers. The destination, the party's ages and access needs, and the rule-out conditions are unanswered, so these were not checked. Season and booking lead time are unknown and left null.

candidatesAccepted.title: Guided groomed-trail snowmobile loop for beginners
candidatesAccepted.summary: Keeps all riding on groomed trails with a guide, which suits the two riders who have not ridden before. The destination, the ages, access needs and the no-go list were not answered, so I could not check any of them and I have not tailored this to them; the location is a placeholder near the Saguenay departure point and the season was not checked.

place.name: Groomed snowmobile trail network near Saguenay

candidatesAccepted.title: Snowshoe day in the Fjord national park
candidatesAccepted.summary: A low-effort winter outing for the riders who want a rest day from the machines, and it works for any ages or access needs once those are known. I did not verify trail conditions, access, or opening dates for January and February.

candidatesAccepted.title: Dog-sled ride on a half-day trail
candidatesAccepted.summary: A quieter alternative to riding that still fits the trip's appetite for effort and gets the group out on snow. Whether a ride is offered on these dates and whether it suits the access needs, which were not answered, are both unknown to me.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed club trail loop from the Lac-Saint-Jean side
candidatesAccepted.summary: A groomed-trail option that fits your preference for fewer kilometres on maintained track over off-trail riding, and suits the mixed experience in the group. I could not account for your destination, ages, access needs or rule-outs, since those were not answered, so this is only a region to check. Trail status and closures come from the local snowmobile club and the Fédération des clubs de motoneigistes du Québec, not from this tool; confirm conditions with them and with Environment Canada before riding.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental machine orientation and a short groomed ride near Saguenay
candidatesAccepted.summary: A gentler entry for the two riders who have not ridden before, using groomed track close to the departure point to limit the distance covered. Your destination and access needs were not answered, so I could not check whether this suits everyone; the rental operator and the local grooming club are the authoritative sources for trail and machine suitability, and nothing here confirms the route is open.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed-trail permit and pass check for the Saguenay area
candidatesAccepted.summary: Confirm the Quebec snowmobile trail pass and any local club membership before leaving, since groomed trails are the stated preference. I could not account for the destination, which was not answered, so this is a regional check and not a route. Ages and access needs were also not answered, so I cannot tell whether any rider needs an extra permit or a different machine.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental snowmobile with insurance and a beginner orientation
candidatesAccepted.summary: Two of the four riders have never ridden, so a rental that includes a short handling orientation and clear insurance terms is worth checking before the trip. The machine is a rental, so confirm what damage and theft cover applies. The rental cost band is wide because I do not know the rental terms, and it may not fit the 900 CAD per-person budget once fees are added.

candidatesAccepted.title: Satellite messenger rental for remote groomed-trail riding
candidatesAccepted.summary: Riding on groomed trails in winter still leaves stretches with weak mobile signal, and a 180 km range between stops adds to that. A rented satellite messenger for the party gives a way to call for help. I have not checked coverage on any specific route, so treat this as a precaution, not a guarantee of signal.
